title: Peterson and CIA director Woolsey invite Steven Greer to dinner

tellings.quote: and his wife uh along with uh James Woolsey, CIA director at the time, and his wife were the people who invited Steven Greer to a uh dinner in the early 90s

plain: A UFO historian, Richard Dolan, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that in the early 1990s a man named John Peterson and his wife, together with James Woolsey, then head of the CIA, the US spy agency, and his wife, invited the UFO campaigner Steven Greer to dinner in the Washington area. Dolan raises it because it would mean the head of US intelligence was personally interested in UFOs.
